title: New explanations and inference for least angle regression
abstract: arXiv:2602.02491v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efron et al. (2004) introduced least angle regression (LAR) as an algorithm for linear predictions, intended as an alternative to forward selection with connections to penalized regression. However, LAR has remained somewhat of a "black box," where some basic behavioral properties of LAR output are not well understood, including an appropriate termination point for the algorithm. We provide a novel framework for inference with LAR, which also allows LAR to be understood from new perspectives with several newly developed mathematical properties. translated_title: 最小角回归的新解释与推断
translated_abstract: Efron等人（2004）提出了最小角回归（LAR）作为线性预测的一种算法，旨在作为前向选择的替代方法，并与惩罚回归存在联系。然而，LAR在某种程度上一直是一个“黑箱”，其输出的一些基本行为特性尚未被很好地理解，包括算法的合适终止点。我们为LAR的推断提供了一个新颖的框架，这也使得LAR能够从新的视角被理解，并由此发展出若干新的数学性质。在数据层面，LAR算法可以被视为估计一个总体层面的对应“路径”，该路径按照总体“相关”参数递减的顺序，沿着回归变量来组织响应均值；这些参数被证明对于解释变量贡献具有有意义的解释，其中零相关表示不重要的变量。
tldr: 本文为最小角回归（LAR）提出了一个新的推断框架，将LAR解释为估计一个按总体相关参数递减排序的变量“路径”，从而揭示其新的数学性质并解决了诸如算法合适终止点等长期悬而未决的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a novel framework for inference with least angle regression (LAR), interpreting it as estimating a population "path" that orders regressors by decreasing population correlation parameters, thereby revealing new mathematical properties and resolving longstanding issues such as the appropriate termination point of the algorithm.
